item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 10/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, it will be appreciably cooler over southern China in the morning in the next couple of days and the weather will improve gradually. A southerly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week gradually. It will be hot during the day with a few showers over the region. Meanwhile, upper-air disturbances will bring thunderstorms to inland southern China.

Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Showers at first. Showers will ease off gradually during the day. Dry with bright periods in the afternoon.
Temp range: 19 - 25 C
R.H. range: 55 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium High
